run_coco_clip_text_features: run the coco_clip_name module to generate CLIP text embeddings for COCO category names
run_coco_clip_with_synonyms: run the module with --avg_synonyms to average CLIP embeddings across WordNet synonyms per category
run_coco_clip_photo_prompts: run the module with --prompt photo to generate CLIP embeddings using 'a photo of a' prompts
run_coco_clip_underscore_names: run the module with --use_underscore to format category names with underscores instead of spaces
run_coco_clip_map_names: run the module with --map_name to normalize category names by lowercasing, replacing underscores, and stripping parentheticals
